verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a local markdown-skills plugin, so it does not host user data. Evidence shows only glancing retention and deletion behavior for its own artifacts. The plan-scoped `.superpowers/sdd/` workspace is automatically deleted once the final review is clean, with git history as the durable record. Worktree removal stops and asks before destroying uncommitted files rather than forcing deletion. missing for 10: user-configurable retention settings, explicit user-initiated deletion controls, documentation of what data is stored or sent and for how long, independent corroboration.
